definitions.explanation: The process of intervening between two disputing parties to help resolve their conflict. Can refer to formal legal arbitration or informal mediation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訴|うった}えた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: They appealed to the international arbitration court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仲裁|ちゅうさい}してくれた。
examples.english: A friend mediated the argument between the two.

examples.japanese: {仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧。
examples.english: They stepped in to mediate and resolved the dispute.

notes:
{仲裁|ちゅうさい} means intervening between disputing parties to help resolve a conflict. It covers both formal legal arbitration and informal mediation between people.

FORMS:
{仲|ちゅう} (between, intermediary) + {裁|さい} (judge, decide)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to step in as mediator
- {仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek arbitration
- {仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧: arbitration court/tribunal
- {仲裁|ちゅうさい}{人|にん}: arbitrator
- {仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: arbitral decision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {仲裁|ちゅうさい}: arbitration (a third party helps decide the outcome)
- ⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧: mediation, conciliation (a third party facilitates discussion)
- ⟦{和解|わかい}→和解：10578_wakai⟧: settlement, reconciliation (the parties reach agreement)
- ⟦{仲直|なかなお}り→仲直り：03127_nakanaori⟧: making up (informal, between friends/family)

REGISTER:
The legal sense is formal. In everyday speech, {仲裁|ちゅうさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ is used casually to mean stepping in to break up an argument.
